chapter: Chicago clubs, entertainers and tent shows
title: Pianist George Hall and the two great Chicago pianists
summary: He remembers George Hall but says Teddy Weatherford and Earl Hines were the only great pianists in Chicago.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Goldie Crosby? I didn't know Goldie Crosby.
Did you know a pianist named George Hall?
I know George Hall, I remember him.
Well, I guess so. I guess he was a good pianist. He was all right. In those days there was only two great pianists in Chicago at that time and that was Teddy
So the rest of them, they were good, but they didn't get the recognition that Earl Hines and Teddy Weatherford got. As pianists.
I learned about George Hall from Lil Armstrong.
Who told me that he could teach her a few things.
Yes, I guess so. That was his way, you know?
